title: Enztronic Office Asset Inventory and Production Requirements
current_evidence: Nine existing PNG references and four existing Markdown context/prompt documents were inspected locally. No GLB, native 3D source, rig, animation library, deployed scene or runtime performance evidence was produced in this handoff.

runtime_stack_recommendation.renderer: Compatible stable Three.js, React Three Fiber and Drei
runtime_stack_recommendation.exact_versions: Resolve against existing React major and current official peer dependencies; pin in lockfile during implementation.
runtime_stack_recommendation.render_boundary: Lazy client-side 3D canvas; server keeps credentials, authorization and real task execution; DOM retains list, inspector and controls.

shared_export_contract.furniture_origin: Footprint center at local finished-floor Y=0
shared_export_contract.transforms: Apply scale/rotation in authored export; preserve deterministic names and measured pivots.
shared_export_contract.material_policy: Portable PBR; correct color spaces; no required Blender-only nodes or missing textures.
shared_export_contract.texture_policy: Embedded or explicitly packaged; mostly 1K with justified 2K exceptions; no default 4K.
shared_export_contract.compression_policy: Optional only after correct uncompressed proof; deployed loader/decoder paths and compressed visual/animation checks required.

skeleton.rig_compatibility: Shared semantic bone layout and deterministic paths; independent runtime skeleton instances.

shared_export_contract.animation_root_policy: No horizontal root translation. Navigation owns movement. Sit/stand animates pelvis/limbs around a fixed floor root; record actual clip durations.
